lines.say: a plant steroid structurally like androgens, from plants used to promote muscle growth
relatives seem to act via estrogen receptors, not as androgens (lab and animal studies)
no change in weight, lean mass or fat vs placebo after 4 weeks in 31 adults (abstract)
IGF-1 didn't change 3 or 24 hours after a single use in 11 men
resting metabolism and fat burning didn't change over 3 hours after a single use in 11 men
